info.name: MIRAI
info.description:
Requests for the MIRAI breast cancer risk model (mitjclinic/mirai), equivalent to what the browser UI sends.

Endpoints documented by the provider:
- GET /info — server and model version information.
- POST /dicom/files — takes .dcm files belonging to a single exam and returns diagnosis scores.

request.description:
Returns server and model version information.

Response fields:
- data.apiVersion (String): version of the API.
- data.modelName (String): name of the model, e.g. "mirai" or "sybil".
- data.modelVersion (String): version of the model. Models with different versions may have different weights.
- message (String): informational or error message, usually null.
- statusCode (Integer): HTTP status code. 200 success, 400 client error, 500 server error.

Takes .dcm files belonging to a single exam and returns diagnosis scores.

Request fields:
- dicom (File): DICOM data files. Click "Select Files" on this single row and multi-select all 4 views at once (CC-R, CC-L, MLO-R, MLO-L) in the same file dialog — do NOT create separate rows for each file, Postman's file picker has a known bug (leftover empty path entry -> EISDIR) when the same key is repeated across multiple rows.
- data (JSON): required freeform JSON object. Anything in it is echoed back in the response's "metadata" field. Can be an empty object {}.

Response fields:
- data.predictions (JSON): list of prediction scores.
- metadata (JSON): freeform object taken from the request's "data" field.
- message (String): informational or error message, usually null.
- statusCode (Integer): HTTP status code. 200 success, 400 client error, 500 server error.
- runtime (String): prediction runtime in seconds, formatted as "123.45s".

formdata.description: Required freeform JSON object. Can be empty ({}). Anything here is echoed back in the response's "metadata" field.
